before_changes: Runner retried every exception up to three attempts with fixed 30/60 second waits; auth errors were not distinguished; retry/reconnect counters were not incremented; each retry starts a fresh collector subprocess which restores configured subscriptions and re-reads current-day candle history.
after_changes: Runner classifies AUTH_FAILURE, NETWORK_FAILURE, RATE_LIMIT, and API_FAILURE; auth stops without retry; retry delay is capped exponential backoff (5, 10 seconds for the runner's two retries); retries start a fresh process/session, re-register subscriptions on the next cycle, and run the existing health scan after success.

runtime_log_timestamp_bounds_bangkok.basis: timestamps embedded in collector/SDK log lines; not a process uptime interval

market_window_transitions.event: 2026-10-24 13:04:26,428 INFO settrade_daily market window state=CLOSED reason=WEEKEND

current_state_telemetry: State transitions, PID, retries, reconnect count, last success, reason, and current delay are written to new runner summaries after the updated runner is used.
checkpoint_policy: Per-symbol candle checkpoints are not reset during reconnect. Current-day request spans midnight to next midnight; the existing deduplicating append path retains genuine rows and flags conflicts.
historical_bbo: Realtime callback gaps cannot be reconstructed; no synthetic BBO is created.
